content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I want to monitor my fuel tank level using my [company_name] [product_name] [version_no]. Does anyone know of a sensor that works with the [product_name]?

Any sensor with a 0 - 10 Volt output will work. Sensors with 2 - 10 Volt output are also suitable. These can be connected directly to the [product_name] if it has analog inputs. If it does not, you will need a [product_name] expansion module. Sensors with 0 - 20mA or 4 - 20mA output signals can also be used. Sensors with a 0 - 5 Volt output will function as well, though resolution will be reduced by half compared to the full range.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wishes to connect an ultrasonic fuel sensor to the [product_name] [version_no] for monitoring a fuel tank and is uncertain about which sensors are compatible. Other users provide details about input signal requirements (e.g., 0–10V, 2–10V, 0–20mA, and 4–20mA) for the [product_name] with analog inputs, and mention that an expansion module may be needed if analog inputs are not present. The main takeaway is that product documentation or interface lacks clear instructions on sensor compatibility, leading users to look for answers within the community.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for easy-to-understand information on which fuel-level sensors are compatible with the [product_name] [version_no], and expects clear guidance on how to integrate sensors into their system.
